_comment: GENERATED from workspace/cron/membership.json by workspace/bin/make-promo-targets -- do not hand-edit. Add or remove a group by editing its 'promos' list in membership.json and regenerating (CI fails if this file drifts). Only groups with status 'active' reach this list, which is why admin-only, not-a-member and on-hold groups are absent. Invite links are NOT reliably resolvable on this gateway, so membership.json records group JIDs.
